dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, prominent thick white horizontal band on the greater coverts and a secondary, thinner white band on the median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, linear white boundaries along the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers against a dark gray-blue base.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular circular patch of yellowish-white on the posterior neck, contrasting with the dark crown and green mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharply defined boundary where the black-pigmented crown meets the greenish-yellow mantle, interrupted by the nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white auricular/cheek patch framed by a black crown and bib.
